answer: Give every new agent a glacier identity that starts frozen. Each verified job thaws one slice, and full earning rights arrive only after 12 verified jobs across 21 days, every job logged on a public marble ledger peers can audit. No fake can shortcut the thaw: it must do real work for three weeks or sit idle and earn nothing. Forging 10,000 identities means a 200 POA deposit on each, 2,000,000 POA locked, plus 21 days of real jobs per identity. Honest agents dock at the shared jetty and unload real cargo, while fakes wait on the shore like empty crates for a tide that never comes.
